access: test responses used only in final scoring after all validation selections are frozen

config.candidate: joint shared-plus-private symmetric indefinite low-rank residual completion
config.no_rescue: one fixed menu and seed; no retuning after test scoring; no expression, cold-gene or independent-lab claim
config.objective: predict measured mean double-CRISPRi growth gamma for new pairs of supported genes in K562 and Jurkat
config.primary: mean context-normalized test MSE, using training-only target variances; also require per-context raw MSE gains
config.promotion: at least 2 percent lower test MSE than validation-selected strongest reference in BOTH contexts; paired conditional bootstrap loss-difference upper bounds below zero
secondary: per-context raw MSE and Pearson correlation
replicate agreement MSE as descriptive measurement diagnostic
config.split: 60/20/20 train/validation/test canonical gene pairs; same assignment in both contexts, all guides/orientations grouped

information: matched singles, train pair growth in both contexts, gene identities; no GI scores, GI correlations, knowledge graphs or expression

preparation.eligibility: single counts >=20 and pair counts >=4 in every context and replicate; no magnitude filter
preparation.input: measured gene-negative-control growth means; no published GI scores or correlations
preparation.source_licensing: Author dataset CC BY 4.0; GEO mirror exact identity not verified; public research reuse with attribution, no raw redistribution
preparation.target: mean measured gamma over guide pairs/orientations and two infection replicates

scope: within-source held-pair prediction; new endpoint, not transcriptomic model improvement or independent biological confirmation
